problems.symptom: The LLM plane was declared totally dead or quota-exhausted repeatedly while the hub was funded or free keys were simply unset.
problems.root_cause: Policy arms were disjoint from keyed models; llm-completion-dispatch had no failover; llmQuotaState reports key presence, not reachability; a provider 401 sets no cooldown.

problems.symptom: Operator declares breakage or landing from a mis-addressed, self-matching, truncated or wrong-clock probe (grep -c lines, || echo 0, wrong WORKSPACE_ROOT, wrong unit, X-Api-Key vs Authorization, host-local vs UTC, client timeout read as server work)
problems.root_cause: Negatives have two generators (absent vs mis-addressed); no positive control through the same address; the rule was written 09-16 and violated again 09-17
